questions.question: Why does the computational cost of inverting the Hessian matrix make standard Newton's method impractical for high-dimensional deep learning?
questions.source_passage: O(n³) cost per step, making it impractical for the very high-dimensional parameter spaces typical in deep learning. Quasi-Newton Methods avoid explicit Hessian inversion.
questions.topic: Newton Method Hessian Inversion O(n³) Complexity

questions.question: What geometric property distinguishes an affine transformation from a general projective homography regarding parallel lines?
questions.source_passage: Affine transformation — combination of translation, rotation, scaling, and shear; preserves parallel lines. Homography (projective transformation) — a general 3×3 matrix mapping that models the transformation between two planar views; does not preserve parallel lines.
questions.topic: Affine vs Homography Parallel Line Preservation

questions.question: Under what constraint qualification condition does strong duality hold with zero duality gap for convex optimization problems?
questions.source_passage: Strong duality — under suitable conditions (e.g., Slater's condition for convex problems), the dual optimal value equals the primal optimal value, i.e., zero duality gap.
